name: Accounting Equation
expr: Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity

name: Owner's Equity
expr: Equity = Assets − Liabilities

name: Net Income
expr: Net Income = Total Revenue − Total Expenses

name: Gross Profit
expr: Gross Profit = Net Sales − Cost of Goods Sold

name: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)
expr: COGS = Opening Stock + Purchases − Closing Stock

name: Trial Balance Rule (concept)
expr: Total Debits must always equal Total Credits

name: Straight Line Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = (Cost − Salvage Value) / Useful Life

name: Reducing Balance Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = Book Value × Rate%

name: Book Value
expr: Book Value = Cost − Accumulated Depreciation

name: Current Ratio
expr: Current Ratio = Current Assets / Current Liabilities

name: Quick Ratio (Acid-Test)
expr: Quick Ratio = (Current Assets − Inventory) / Current Liabilities

name: Gross Profit Ratio
expr: GP Ratio = (Gross Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: Net Profit Ratio
expr: NP Ratio = (Net Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: Debt-to-Equity Ratio
expr: D/E Ratio = Total Debt / Total Equity

name: Return on Equity (ROE)
expr: ROE = (Net Income / Shareholder Equity) × 100

name: Return on Assets (ROA)
expr: ROA = (Net Income / Total Assets) × 100

name: Inventory Turnover Ratio
expr: Inventory Turnover = COGS / Average Inventory

name: Earnings Per Share (EPS)
expr: EPS = Net Income / Number of Outstanding Shares

name: Total Cost
expr: Total Cost = Fixed Cost + Variable Cost

name: Contribution Margin
expr: Contribution Margin = Selling Price − Variable Cost per Unit

name: Break-Even Point (Units)
expr: BEP = Fixed Costs / Contribution Margin per Unit

name: Margin of Safety
expr: Margin of Safety = Actual Sales − Break-Even Sales

name: Present Value (PV)
expr: PV = FV / (1 + r)ⁿ

name: Future Value (FV)
expr: FV = PV × (1 + r)ⁿ

name: Net Present Value (NPV) (concept)
expr: the sum of the present values of all future cash flows, minus the initial investment

name: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) (concept)
expr: the discount rate at which the NPV of a project becomes exactly zero

name: Working Capital
expr: Working Capital = Current Assets − Current Liabilities

name: Payback Period
expr: Payback Period = Initial Investment / Annual Cash Inflow

name: Net Sales
expr: Net Sales = Gross Sales − Sales Returns − Trade Discounts

name: Net Purchases
expr: Net Purchases = Purchases − Purchase Returns + Carriage Inwards

name: Operating Profit
expr: Operating Profit = Gross Profit − Operating Expenses

name: Net Profit After Tax
expr: Net Profit After Tax = EBT − Income Tax

name: Closing Capital
expr: Closing Capital = Opening Capital + Net Profit + Additional Capital − Drawings

name: Net Profit (Single Entry / Statement of Affairs)
expr: Net Profit = Closing Capital − Opening Capital + Drawings − Additional Capital

name: Expense for the Period (Accrued)
expr: Expense = Cash Paid + Closing Accrued − Opening Accrued

name: Expense for the Period (Prepaid)
expr: Expense = Cash Paid + Opening Prepaid − Closing Prepaid

name: Provision for Doubtful Debts
expr: Provision = Debtors × Provision %

name: Net Realizable Debtors
expr: Net Debtors = Debtors − Provision for Doubtful Debts

name: Trade Discount
expr: Trade Discount = List Price × Trade Discount %

name: Cash Discount
expr: Cash Discount = Invoice Amount × Cash Discount %

name: Invoice Total with Sales Tax
expr: Invoice Total = Net Price + (Net Price × Tax Rate / 100)

name: Adjusted Bank Balance (Reconciliation)
expr: Adjusted Balance = Bank Statement Balance + Deposits in Transit − Outstanding Cheques

name: Prime Cost
expr: Prime Cost = Direct Materials + Direct Labour + Direct Expenses

name: Cost of Production
expr: Cost of Production = Prime Cost + Factory Overheads

name: Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM)
expr: COGM = Opening WIP + Total Manufacturing Cost − Closing WIP

name: Depreciable Amount
expr: Depreciable Amount = Cost − Residual Value

name: Straight Line Depreciation Rate
expr: Rate % = (Annual Depreciation / Cost) × 100

name: Accumulated Depreciation (Straight Line)
expr: Accumulated Depreciation = Annual Depreciation × Years Used

name: Units of Production Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = ((Cost − Salvage) / Total Estimated Units) × Units Produced

name: Sum-of-the-Years'-Digits (SYD) Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = (Cost − Salvage) × Remaining Life / [n(n + 1)/2]

name: Double Declining Balance Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = (2 / Useful Life) × Book Value at Start of Year

name: Part-Year Depreciation
expr: Depreciation = Annual Depreciation × (Months Used / 12)

name: Gain or Loss on Disposal of Asset
expr: Gain/Loss = Sale Proceeds − Book Value

name: Depletion per Unit
expr: Depletion per Unit = (Cost − Residual Value) / Estimated Total Units

name: Amortization of Intangible Asset
expr: Amortization = Cost / Useful Life

name: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE)
expr: ROCE = (EBIT / (Total Assets − Current Liabilities)) × 100

name: Operating Profit Ratio
expr: Operating Profit Ratio = (Operating Profit / Net Sales) × 100

name: EBITDA
expr: EBITDA = Net Income + Interest + Taxes + Depreciation + Amortization

name: Cash Ratio
expr: Cash Ratio = (Cash + Marketable Securities) / Current Liabilities

name: Proprietary Ratio
expr: Proprietary Ratio = Shareholders' Equity / Total Assets

name: Debt Ratio
expr: Debt Ratio = Total Liabilities / Total Assets

name: Interest Coverage Ratio
expr: Interest Coverage = EBIT / Interest Expense

name: Capital Gearing Ratio
expr: Gearing = (Preference Capital + Debentures + Long-term Loans) / Equity Shareholders' Funds

name: Fixed Asset Turnover Ratio
expr: Fixed Asset Turnover = Net Sales / Net Fixed Assets

name: Total Asset Turnover Ratio
expr: Asset Turnover = Net Sales / Average Total Assets

name: Debtors (Receivables) Turnover Ratio
expr: Debtors Turnover = Net Credit Sales / Average Debtors

name: Average Collection Period
expr: Collection Period = 365 / Debtors Turnover

name: Creditors (Payables) Turnover Ratio
expr: Creditors Turnover = Net Credit Purchases / Average Creditors

name: Average Payment Period
expr: Payment Period = 365 / Creditors Turnover

name: Days Inventory Outstanding
expr: DIO = 365 / Inventory Turnover

name: Cash Conversion Cycle
expr: CCC = DIO + DSO − DPO

name: Working Capital Turnover Ratio
expr: Working Capital Turnover = Net Sales / Working Capital

name: Dividend Payout Ratio
expr: Payout Ratio = (Dividends / Net Income) × 100

name: Dividend Per Share (DPS)
expr: DPS = Total Dividends / Number of Shares

name: Price-Earnings (P/E) Ratio
expr: P/E = Market Price per Share / EPS

name: Earnings Yield
expr: Earnings Yield = (EPS / Market Price per Share) × 100

name: Book Value per Share
expr: BVPS = (Total Equity − Preference Capital) / Ordinary Shares

name: Equity Multiplier
expr: Equity Multiplier = Total Assets / Total Equity

name: DuPont Identity
expr: ROE = Net Profit Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier

name: Free Cash Flow
expr: FCF = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditure

name: Profit-Volume (P/V) Ratio
expr: P/V Ratio = (Contribution / Sales) × 100

name: Break-Even Sales (Value)
expr: Break-Even Sales = Fixed Costs / P/V Ratio

name: Target Profit Sales (Units)
expr: Units = (Fixed Costs + Target Profit) / Contribution per Unit

name: Margin of Safety Ratio
expr: MOS Ratio = ((Actual Sales − Break-Even Sales) / Actual Sales) × 100

name: Cost-Volume-Profit Equation
expr: Profit = (Selling Price − Variable Cost per Unit) × Units − Fixed Costs

name: Variable Cost per Unit
expr: VC per Unit = Total Variable Cost / Units Produced

name: Average Cost per Unit
expr: Average Cost = Total Cost / Units Produced

name: Marginal Cost
expr: Marginal Cost = Change in Total Cost / Change in Quantity

name: Degree of Operating Leverage (DOL)
expr: DOL = Contribution Margin / EBIT

name: Markup Percentage
expr: Markup % = (Gross Profit / Cost) × 100

name: Selling Price from Markup
expr: Selling Price = Cost × (1 + Markup %)

name: Overhead Absorption Rate
expr: OAR = Budgeted Overheads / Budgeted Activity Base

name: Over/Under-Absorbed Overhead
expr: Over/(Under) Absorbed = Absorbed Overhead − Actual Overhead

name: Material Price Variance
expr: MPV = (Standard Price − Actual Price) × Actual Quantity

name: Material Usage Variance
expr: MUV = (Standard Quantity − Actual Quantity) × Standard Price

name: Labour Rate Variance
expr: LRV = (Standard Rate − Actual Rate) × Actual Hours

name: Labour Efficiency Variance
expr: LEV = (Standard Hours − Actual Hours) × Standard Rate

name: Economic Order Quantity (EOQ)
expr: EOQ = √(2 × Annual Demand × Ordering Cost / Holding Cost per Unit)

name: Reorder Level
expr: Reorder Level = Maximum Usage × Maximum Lead Time

name: Minimum Stock Level
expr: Minimum Level = Reorder Level − (Normal Usage × Normal Lead Time)

name: Maximum Stock Level
expr: Maximum Level = Reorder Level + Reorder Qty − (Min Usage × Min Lead Time)

name: Effective Annual Rate (EAR)
expr: EAR = (1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1

name: Continuous Compounding
expr: A = P × e^(rt)

name: Discount Factor
expr: Discount Factor = 1 / (1 + r)ⁿ

name: Present Value of Ordinary Annuity
expr: PV = PMT × [1 − (1 + r)⁻ⁿ] / r

name: Future Value of Ordinary Annuity
expr: FV = PMT × [(1 + r)ⁿ − 1] / r

name: Perpetuity Value
expr: PV = C / r

name: Growing Perpetuity Value
expr: PV = C / (r − g)

name: Rule of 72
expr: Years to Double ≈ 72 / Interest Rate %

name: Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)
expr: CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) − 1

name: Real Interest Rate (Fisher Equation)
expr: 1 + Real Rate = (1 + Nominal Rate) / (1 + Inflation Rate)

name: Profitability Index
expr: PI = PV of Future Cash Flows / Initial Investment

name: Accounting Rate of Return (ARR)
expr: ARR = (Average Annual Profit / Average Investment) × 100

name: Bond Price
expr: Price = Σ [C / (1 + r)ᵗ] + FV / (1 + r)ⁿ

name: Current Yield of a Bond
expr: Current Yield = Annual Coupon / Market Price

name: Holding Period Return
expr: HPR = (Ending Value − Beginning Value + Income) / Beginning Value

name: Expected Return
expr: E(R) = Σ (Probability × Return)

name: Cost of Equity (CAPM)
expr: Re = Rf + β × (Rm − Rf)

name: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
expr: WACC = (E/V) × Re + (D/V) × Rd × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Gordon Growth (Dividend Discount) Model
expr: P₀ = D₁ / (Re − g)

name: Sharpe Ratio
expr: Sharpe = (Rp − Rf) / σp

name: Coefficient of Variation (Investment)
expr: CV = Standard Deviation / Expected Return

name: Portfolio Return (Two Assets)
expr: Rp = w₁R₁ + w₂R₂

name: Zakat on Wealth
expr: Zakat = 2.5% × Zakatable Wealth held for one lunar year

name: Nisab Threshold (concept)
expr: Nisab = 87.48 g of gold or 612.36 g of silver in value

name: Murabaha Selling Price
expr: Selling Price = Cost Price + Agreed Profit Margin

name: Partner's Share of Profit
expr: Share = Divisible Profit × Partner's Profit Ratio

name: Interest on Partner's Capital
expr: Interest = Capital × Rate × Time / 100

name: Interest on Drawings (Average Period)
expr: Interest = Total Drawings × Rate/100 × Average Period (e.g. 6.5/12 if drawn monthly at start)

name: Sacrificing Ratio
expr: Sacrificing Ratio = Old Ratio − New Ratio

name: Gaining Ratio
expr: Gaining Ratio = New Ratio − Old Ratio

name: New Profit Sharing Ratio
expr: New Ratio = Old Share − Sacrificed Share + Gained Share

name: Normal Profit
expr: Normal Profit = Capital Employed × Normal Rate of Return / 100

name: Super Profit
expr: Super Profit = Actual Average Profit − Normal Profit

name: Goodwill (Average Profit Method)
expr: Goodwill = Average Profit × Number of Years' Purchase

name: Goodwill (Super Profit Method)
expr: Goodwill = Super Profit × Number of Years' Purchase

name: Goodwill (Capitalisation Method)
expr: Goodwill = (Average Profit × 100 / Normal Rate) − Net Assets

name: Capital Employed
expr: Capital Employed = Total Assets − Current Liabilities

name: Partner's Closing Capital
expr: Closing = Opening + Additional Capital + Interest on Capital + Profit Share − Drawings − Interest on Drawings

name: Amount Due to Retiring Partner
expr: Due = Capital + Share of Goodwill + Share of Reserves & Profit − Drawings

name: Called-Up Share Capital
expr: Called-Up Capital = Number of Shares × Amount Called per Share

name: Calls in Arrears
expr: Calls in Arrears = Called-Up Capital − Paid-Up Capital

name: Share Premium
expr: Share Premium = Issue Price − Face Value

name: Bonus Shares Issued
expr: Bonus Shares = Existing Shares × Bonus Ratio

name: Theoretical Ex-Rights Price (TERP)
expr: TERP = (N × Cum-Rights Price + Issue Price) / (N + 1)

name: Value of a Right
expr: Value of Right = Cum-Rights Price − TERP

name: Weighted Average Shares Outstanding
expr: Weighted Shares = Σ (Shares × Months Outstanding / 12)

name: Diluted EPS
expr: Diluted EPS = (Net Income − Pref. Dividends + After-Tax Convertible Interest) / (Weighted Shares + Convertible Shares)

name: Debenture Interest
expr: Interest = Face Value of Debentures × Coupon Rate

name: Closing Retained Earnings
expr: Retained Earnings = Opening Balance + Net Income − Dividends

name: Sinking Fund Installment
expr: Installment = FV × r / [(1 + r)ⁿ − 1]

name: Interest Tax Shield
expr: Tax Shield = Interest Expense × Tax Rate

name: Market Capitalization
expr: Market Cap = Share Price × Shares Outstanding

name: Enterprise Value (EV)
expr: EV = Market Cap + Total Debt − Cash

name: EV/EBITDA Multiple
expr: EV/EBITDA = Enterprise Value / EBITDA

name: Price-to-Book (P/B) Ratio
expr: P/B = Market Price per Share / Book Value per Share

name: Price-to-Sales (P/S) Ratio
expr: P/S = Market Cap / Total Revenue

name: PEG Ratio
expr: PEG = P/E Ratio / Annual EPS Growth %

name: Common-Size Statement
expr: Item % = (Line Item / Base Figure) × 100 (base = Sales or Total Assets)

name: Trend Percentage
expr: Trend % = (Current Year Value / Base Year Value) × 100

name: Horizontal Analysis Change %
expr: Change % = ((Current − Previous) / Previous) × 100

name: Defensive Interval Ratio
expr: DIR = (Cash + Securities + Receivables) / Daily Operating Expenses

name: Operating Cash Flow Ratio
expr: OCF Ratio = Operating Cash Flow / Current Liabilities

name: Cash Flow to Debt Ratio
expr: Cash Flow to Debt = Operating Cash Flow / Total Debt

name: Cash Flow Margin
expr: Cash Flow Margin = (Operating Cash Flow / Net Sales) × 100

name: Quality of Earnings Ratio
expr: Quality of Earnings = Operating Cash Flow / Net Income

name: EBIT Margin
expr: EBIT Margin = (EBIT / Net Sales) × 100

name: EBITDA Margin
expr: EBITDA Margin = (EBITDA / Net Sales) × 100

name: Return on Common Equity
expr: ROCE = (Net Income − Preference Dividends) / Average Common Equity

name: Retention Ratio
expr: Retention Ratio = 1 − Dividend Payout Ratio

name: Sustainable Growth Rate
expr: SGR = ROE × Retention Ratio

name: Internal Growth Rate
expr: IGR = (ROA × b) / (1 − ROA × b), where b = retention ratio

name: Altman Z-Score
expr: Z = 1.2(WC/TA) + 1.4(RE/TA) + 3.3(EBIT/TA) + 0.6(MVE/TL) + 1.0(Sales/TA)

name: Net Debt
expr: Net Debt = Total Debt − Cash & Equivalents

name: Debt-to-EBITDA Ratio
expr: Debt/EBITDA = Total Debt / EBITDA

name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)
expr: DSCR = Net Operating Income / Total Debt Service

name: Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio
expr: FCCR = (EBIT + Lease Payments) / (Interest + Lease Payments)

name: Long-Term Debt to Equity
expr: LT Debt/Equity = Long-Term Debt / Shareholders' Equity

name: Capitalization Ratio
expr: Capitalization = Long-Term Debt / (Long-Term Debt + Equity)

name: Operating Cycle
expr: Operating Cycle = Days Inventory Outstanding + Days Sales Outstanding

name: Tax Burden Ratio
expr: Tax Burden = Net Income / EBT

name: Interest Burden Ratio
expr: Interest Burden = EBT / EBIT

name: Effective Tax Rate
expr: Effective Tax Rate = (Income Tax Expense / EBT) × 100

name: Flexible Budget
expr: Flexible Budget = Fixed Cost + (Variable Cost per Unit × Actual Activity)

name: Budgeted Production (Units)
expr: Production = Budgeted Sales + Closing Stock − Opening Stock

name: Purchases Budget
expr: Purchases = Budgeted COGS + Closing Inventory − Opening Inventory

name: Cash Budget Closing Balance
expr: Closing Cash = Opening Cash + Receipts − Payments

name: Budget Variance
expr: Variance = Actual − Budget

name: NOPAT
expr: NOPAT = EBIT × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Return on Invested Capital (ROIC)
expr: ROIC = NOPAT / Invested Capital

name: Economic Value Added (EVA)
expr: EVA = NOPAT − (WACC × Invested Capital)

name: Residual Income
expr: RI = Operating Income − (Required Return × Operating Assets)

name: Minimum Transfer Price
expr: Transfer Price = Variable Cost per Unit + Opportunity Cost per Unit

name: Contribution per Limiting Factor
expr: Ranking Basis = Contribution per Unit / Limiting Factor Used per Unit

name: Learning Curve Model
expr: Y = a × Xᵇ, where b = log(Learning Rate) / log 2

name: Total Material Cost Variance
expr: MCV = (Standard Qty × Standard Price) − (Actual Qty × Actual Price)

name: Total Labour Cost Variance
expr: LCV = (Standard Hours × Standard Rate) − (Actual Hours × Actual Rate)

name: Idle Time Variance
expr: Idle Time Variance = Idle Hours × Standard Rate

name: Fixed Overhead Expenditure Variance
expr: Variance = Budgeted Fixed Overhead − Actual Fixed Overhead

name: Fixed Overhead Volume Variance
expr: Variance = (Actual Output − Budgeted Output) × Standard Fixed Overhead Rate

name: Sales Volume Variance
expr: Variance = (Actual Units − Budgeted Units) × Standard Margin per Unit

name: Job Cost
expr: Job Cost = Direct Materials + Direct Labour + Applied Overhead

name: Notional Profit (Contract Costing)
expr: Notional Profit = Value of Work Certified − Cost of Work Done

name: Equivalent Units (Process Costing)
expr: Equivalent Units = Completed Units + (WIP Units × % Completion)

name: Cost per Equivalent Unit
expr: Cost per Equivalent Unit = Total Process Cost / Equivalent Units

name: Cost per Unit with Normal Loss
expr: Cost per Unit = (Total Cost − Scrap Value of Normal Loss) / (Input − Normal Loss Units)

name: Net Realizable Value (NRV)
expr: NRV = Final Selling Price − Separable Costs

name: Joint Cost Allocation (NRV Method)
expr: Allocated Cost = (NRV of Product / Total NRV) × Joint Cost

name: Activity-Based Costing Rate
expr: Activity Rate = Cost Pool / Cost Driver Volume

name: Machine Hour Rate
expr: Machine Hour Rate = Total Overhead / Total Machine Hours

name: Halsey Premium Plan
expr: Earnings = (Time Taken × Rate) + 50% × (Time Saved × Rate)

name: Rowan Plan
expr: Earnings = (Time Taken × Rate) + (Time Saved / Time Allowed) × Time Taken × Rate

name: Labour Turnover Rate
expr: Labour Turnover % = (Separations / Average Workers) × 100

name: Safety Stock
expr: Safety Stock = (Max Daily Usage × Max Lead Time) − (Avg Daily Usage × Avg Lead Time)

name: Total Inventory Cost
expr: Total Cost = (D/Q) × S + (Q/2) × H

name: GMROII
expr: GMROII = Gross Margin / Average Inventory at Cost

name: Cost-to-Retail Ratio (Retail Method)
expr: Ratio = Cost of Goods Available / Retail Value of Goods Available

name: Gross Profit Method (Estimated Ending Inventory)
expr: Ending Inventory = Goods Available − Sales × (1 − Gross Profit %)

name: Net Present Value (Formula)
expr: NPV = Σ [CFₜ / (1 + r)ᵗ] − Initial Investment

name: IRR (Linear Interpolation)
expr: IRR ≈ Low Rate + [NPV_low / (NPV_low − NPV_high)] × (High Rate − Low Rate)

name: Payback Period (Uneven Cash Flows)
expr: Payback = Years Before Recovery + (Unrecovered Amount / Cash Flow in Recovery Year)

name: Discounted Payback Period
expr: DPP = Years Before Recovery + (Unrecovered PV / PV of Cash Flow in Recovery Year)

name: Equivalent Annual Annuity (EAA)
expr: EAA = NPV × r / [1 − (1 + r)⁻ⁿ]

name: Modified IRR (MIRR)
expr: MIRR = (FV of Positive Cash Flows / PV of Negative Cash Flows)^(1/n) − 1

name: Taxable Income
expr: Taxable Income = Gross Income − Allowable Deductions

name: Tax Payable
expr: Tax Payable = Taxable Income × Tax Rate

name: Sales Tax Payable
expr: Sales Tax Payable = Output Tax − Input Tax

name: Deferred Tax
expr: Deferred Tax = Temporary Difference × Tax Rate

name: Net Salary
expr: Net Salary = Gross Salary − Tax − Other Deductions

name: Gross-Up Amount
expr: Gross Amount = Net Amount / (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Zakat on Business Assets
expr: Zakat = 2.5% × (Current Assets − Current Liabilities)

name: Ushr (Agricultural Zakat)
expr: Ushr = 10% of produce (rain-fed land) or 5% (irrigated land)

name: Mudarabah Profit Share
expr: Partner Profit = Total Profit × Agreed Profit Ratio

name: Ijarah Rental
expr: Rental = (Asset Cost + Lessor's Return) / Number of Periods

name: Bank Discount
expr: Bank Discount = Face Value × Discount Rate × Time

name: Proceeds of a Discounted Bill
expr: Proceeds = Face Value − Bank Discount

name: Maturity Value (Simple Interest)
expr: MV = P(1 + rt)

name: Daily Periodic Rate
expr: Daily Rate = APR / 365

name: Net Interest Margin (NIM)
expr: NIM = (Interest Income − Interest Expense) / Average Earning Assets

name: Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR)
expr: CAR = ((Tier 1 + Tier 2 Capital) / Risk-Weighted Assets) × 100

name: Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
expr: NPL Ratio = (Non-Performing Loans / Total Loans) × 100

name: Cash Reserve Requirement
expr: Required Reserve = Deposits × CRR %

name: Money Multiplier
expr: Money Multiplier = 1 / Reserve Ratio

name: Interest Rate Spread
expr: Spread = Lending Rate − Deposit Rate

name: Insurance Premium
expr: Premium = Sum Insured × Premium Rate

name: Average Clause (Underinsurance)
expr: Claim = (Sum Insured / Value of Property) × Loss

name: Insurance Loss Ratio
expr: Loss Ratio = (Claims Incurred / Earned Premiums) × 100

name: Interest Portion of Loan Payment
expr: Interest = Outstanding Balance × Periodic Rate

name: Principal Portion of Loan Payment
expr: Principal = EMI − Interest Portion

name: Total Interest Paid on a Loan
expr: Total Interest = (EMI × n) − Loan Amount

name: Beta Coefficient
expr: β = Cov(Rᵢ, Rₘ) / Var(Rₘ)

name: Treynor Ratio
expr: Treynor = (Rp − Rf) / βp

name: Jensen's Alpha
expr: α = Rp − [Rf + β(Rm − Rf)]

name: Portfolio Variance (Two Assets)
expr: σp² = w₁²σ₁² + w₂²σ₂² + 2w₁w₂ρσ₁σ₂

name: Correlation Coefficient (Returns)
expr: ρ = Cov(x, y) / (σx × σy)

name: Parametric Value at Risk (VaR)
expr: VaR = Portfolio Value × z × σ

name: Capital Gains Yield
expr: Capital Gains Yield = (P₁ − P₀) / P₀

name: Total Stock Return
expr: Total Return = Dividend Yield + Capital Gains Yield

name: Macaulay Duration
expr: D = Σ [t × PV(CFₜ)] / Bond Price

name: Modified Duration
expr: Modified Duration = Macaulay Duration / (1 + y/n)

name: Bond Price Change (Duration)
expr: %ΔPrice ≈ −Modified Duration × Δy

name: Zero-Coupon Bond Price
expr: Price = Face Value / (1 + r)ⁿ

name: Forward Price
expr: F = S × (1 + r)ᵀ

name: Put-Call Parity
expr: C + K/(1 + r)ᵀ = P + S

name: Call Option Intrinsic Value
expr: Intrinsic Value = max(S − K, 0)

name: Black-Scholes Call Price
expr: C = S·N(d₁) − K·e^(−rT)·N(d₂)

name: Black-Scholes d₁ and d₂
expr: d₁ = [ln(S/K) + (r + σ²/2)T] / (σ√T); d₂ = d₁ − σ√T

name: Currency Conversion
expr: Amount in Foreign Currency = Amount in Home Currency × Exchange Rate

name: Cross Exchange Rate
expr: A/C = (A/B) × (B/C)

name: Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)
expr: S = P_domestic / P_foreign

name: Interest Rate Parity
expr: F / S = (1 + i_domestic) / (1 + i_foreign)

name: Inflation Rate
expr: Inflation % = ((CPIₜ − CPIₜ₋₁) / CPIₜ₋₁) × 100

name: Capitalization Rate (Real Estate)
expr: Cap Rate = Net Operating Income / Property Value

name: Sales Returns Ratio
expr: Sales Returns Ratio = (Sales Returns / Gross Sales) × 100

name: Credit Sales
expr: Credit Sales = Total Sales − Cash Sales

name: Credit Purchases
expr: Credit Purchases = Total Purchases − Cash Purchases

name: Closing Debtors (Total Debtors Account)
expr: Closing Debtors = Opening Debtors + Credit Sales − Cash Received − Discount Allowed − Returns − Bad Debts

name: Closing Creditors (Total Creditors Account)
expr: Closing Creditors = Opening Creditors + Credit Purchases − Cash Paid − Discount Received − Returns

name: Total Assets
expr: Total Assets = Fixed Assets + Current Assets

name: Net Fixed Assets
expr: Net Fixed Assets = Gross Fixed Assets − Accumulated Depreciation

name: Net Worth
expr: Net Worth = Total Assets − Total Liabilities

name: Provision for Discount on Debtors
expr: Provision = (Debtors − Provision for Bad Debts) × Discount %

name: Trial Balance Difference (Suspense)
expr: Suspense = |Total Debits − Total Credits|

name: Interest on Loan
expr: Interest = Loan × Rate × Time / 100

name: Funds from Operations
expr: FFO = Net Profit + Non-Fund Expenses (e.g. Depreciation) − Non-Fund Gains

name: Cash from Operations (Indirect Method)
expr: CFO = Net Income + Depreciation ± Changes in Working Capital

name: Net Change in Cash
expr: Net Change = Operating CF + Investing CF + Financing CF

name: Change in Net Working Capital
expr: ΔNWC = ΔCurrent Assets − ΔCurrent Liabilities

name: Consignment Profit
expr: Profit = Sales − Cost of Goods − Expenses − Commission

name: Loading on Invoice Price
expr: Loading = Invoice Price − Cost Price

name: Royalty Payable
expr: Royalty = Units Produced (or Sold) × Royalty per Unit

name: Hire Purchase Interest
expr: Interest = Total Hire Purchase Price − Cash Price

name: Hire Purchase Installment
expr: Installment = (Cash Price − Down Payment + Interest) / Number of Installments

name: Lease Liability (Present Value)
expr: Lease Liability = Σ [Lease Payment / (1 + r)ᵗ]

name: Finance Lease Interest
expr: Interest = Opening Lease Liability × Interest Rate

name: Subscription Income (NPO)
expr: Income = Received + Closing Outstanding − Opening Outstanding + Opening Advance − Closing Advance

name: Capital Fund (Non-Profit)
expr: Capital Fund = Total Assets − Total Liabilities

name: Surplus or Deficit (Income & Expenditure)
expr: Surplus/Deficit = Total Income − Total Expenditure

name: Profit Percentage (on Cost)
expr: Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) × 100

name: Loss Percentage
expr: Loss % = (Loss / Cost Price) × 100

name: Profit Percentage on Selling Price
expr: Profit % = (Profit / Selling Price) × 100

name: Discount Percentage
expr: Discount % = (Discount / Marked Price) × 100

name: Marked Price
expr: Marked Price = Cost × (1 + Profit %) / (1 − Discount %)

name: Successive Discounts
expr: Net Price = List Price × (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)(1 − d₃)

name: Commission Earned
expr: Commission = Sales Value × Commission Rate

name: True Discount
expr: True Discount = Amount Due − Present Value

name: Banker's Gain
expr: Banker's Gain = Banker's Discount − True Discount

name: Average Due Date
expr: Average Due Date = Base Date + Σ(Amount × Days) / Σ Amount

name: After-Tax Cost of Debt
expr: Kd(after-tax) = Kd × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Cost of Preferred Stock
expr: Kp = Preferred Dividend / Net Issue Price

name: Cost of New Equity (Flotation Adjusted)
expr: Ke = D₁ / [P₀(1 − f)] + g

name: MM Proposition I (with Taxes)
expr: V_L = V_U + (Tax Rate × Debt)

name: Degree of Financial Leverage (DFL)
expr: DFL = EBIT / (EBIT − Interest)

name: Degree of Combined Leverage (DCL)
expr: DCL = DOL × DFL

name: EBIT-EPS Indifference Point
expr: (EBIT − I₁)(1 − T) / S₁ = (EBIT − I₂)(1 − T) / S₂

name: Financial Break-Even EBIT
expr: EBIT = Interest + Preference Dividend / (1 − T)

name: Terminal Value (Gordon Growth)
expr: TV = FCF × (1 + g) / (WACC − g)

name: Enterprise Value (DCF)
expr: EV = Σ [FCFₜ / (1 + WACC)ᵗ] + TV / (1 + WACC)ⁿ

name: Equity Value
expr: Equity Value = Enterprise Value − Net Debt

name: Intrinsic Value per Share
expr: Value per Share = Equity Value / Shares Outstanding

name: Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF)
expr: FCFF = EBIT(1 − T) + Depreciation − CapEx − ΔNWC

name: Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE)
expr: FCFE = FCFF − Interest(1 − T) + Net Borrowing

name: Preferred Stock Value
expr: Value = Preferred Dividend / Required Return

name: Walter Dividend Model
expr: P = [D + (r/Ke)(E − D)] / Ke

name: Gordon Dividend Model (Retention Form)
expr: P = E(1 − b) / (k − br)

name: Stock Split Price Adjustment
expr: New Price = Old Price / Split Ratio

name: Shares Repurchased (Buyback)
expr: Shares Bought Back = Buyback Amount / Repurchase Price

name: Residual Dividend Policy
expr: Dividend = Net Income − (Target Equity Ratio × Capital Expenditure)

name: Miller-Orr Spread
expr: Spread = 3 × [(3/4 × Transaction Cost × Variance) / Interest Rate]^(1/3)

name: Miller-Orr Return Point
expr: Return Point = Lower Limit + Spread / 3

name: Cost of Forgoing Cash Discount
expr: Cost = [d / (1 − d)] × [365 / (Credit Period − Discount Period)]

name: Average Receivables Investment
expr: Average Receivables = Daily Credit Sales × Average Collection Period

name: Portfolio Weight
expr: Weight = Value of Asset / Total Portfolio Value

name: Bond Coupon Payment
expr: Coupon = Face Value × Coupon Rate

name: Bond Premium/Discount Amortization (Straight Line)
expr: Annual Amortization = (Issue Price − Face Value) / Years to Maturity

name: Bond Interest Expense (Effective Interest Method)
expr: Interest Expense = Carrying Value × Market Rate

name: Approximate Yield to Call
expr: YTC ≈ [C + (Call Price − P)/n] / [(Call Price + P)/2]

name: Conversion Ratio
expr: Conversion Ratio = Face Value / Conversion Price

name: Conversion Value
expr: Conversion Value = Share Price × Conversion Ratio

name: Conversion Premium
expr: Conversion Premium = Bond Price − Conversion Value

name: High-Low Method (Variable Cost)
expr: VC per Unit = (High Cost − Low Cost) / (High Activity − Low Activity)

name: High-Low Method (Fixed Cost)
expr: Fixed Cost = Total Cost − (VC per Unit × Activity Level)

name: Linear Cost Function
expr: Y = a + bX (a = fixed cost, b = variable cost per unit)

name: Weighted Average Contribution Margin
expr: WACM = Σ (Sales Mix % × Contribution Margin per Unit)

name: Composite Break-Even Point (Units)
expr: BEP = Fixed Costs / WACM

name: Incremental Profit
expr: Incremental Profit = Incremental Revenue − Incremental Cost

name: Opportunity Cost (concept)
expr: Value of the next best alternative given up

name: Shutdown Rule (concept)
expr: Shut down if Revenue < Avoidable (Variable) Costs

name: Capacity Utilization
expr: Utilization % = (Actual Output / Capacity) × 100

name: Idle Capacity Cost
expr: Idle Cost = (Budgeted Hours − Actual Hours) × Overhead Rate

name: Throughput
expr: Throughput = Sales Revenue − Totally Variable Costs

name: Throughput Accounting Ratio
expr: TPAR = Throughput per Bottleneck Hour / Cost per Bottleneck Hour

name: Target Cost
expr: Target Cost = Target Selling Price − Target Profit

name: Cost of Quality
expr: COQ = Prevention + Appraisal + Internal Failure + External Failure Costs

name: Exponential Smoothing Forecast
expr: Fₜ₊₁ = αAₜ + (1 − α)Fₜ

name: Simple Moving Average Forecast
expr: MA = (A₁ + A₂ + … + Aₙ) / n

name: Sales Mix Variance
expr: (Actual Units Sold − Actual Total Units at Budgeted Mix) × Standard Margin

name: Material Yield Variance
expr: (Actual Yield − Standard Yield for Actual Input) × Standard Cost per Unit of Output

name: Variable Overhead Efficiency Variance
expr: (Standard Hours − Actual Hours) × Standard Variable Overhead Rate

name: Variable Overhead Expenditure Variance
expr: (Standard Rate × Actual Hours) − Actual Variable Overhead

name: Fixed Overhead Capacity Variance
expr: (Actual Hours − Budgeted Hours) × Standard Fixed Overhead Rate per Hour

name: Total Overhead Variance
expr: Overhead Variance = Absorbed Overhead − Actual Overhead

name: Standard Cost of Actual Output
expr: Standard Cost = Actual Output × Standard Cost per Unit

name: Efficiency Ratio (Labour)
expr: Efficiency % = (Standard Hours for Actual Output / Actual Hours) × 100

name: Capacity Ratio
expr: Capacity % = (Actual Hours / Budgeted Hours) × 100

name: Activity Ratio
expr: Activity % = (Standard Hours for Actual Output / Budgeted Hours) × 100

name: Savings Rate
expr: Savings Rate = (Savings / Income) × 100

name: Debt-to-Income Ratio (DTI)
expr: DTI = (Monthly Debt Payments / Gross Monthly Income) × 100

name: Emergency Fund Target
expr: Emergency Fund = Monthly Expenses × Number of Months

name: Retirement Corpus Required
expr: Corpus = Annual Expenses / Safe Withdrawal Rate

name: Inflation-Adjusted Future Cost
expr: Future Cost = Present Cost × (1 + i)ⁿ

name: Rule of 114 (Tripling Time)
expr: Years to Triple ≈ 114 / Interest Rate %

name: Credit Utilization Ratio
expr: Utilization = (Credit Balance / Credit Limit) × 100

name: Tax-Equivalent Yield
expr: Tax-Equivalent Yield = Tax-Free Yield / (1 − Tax Rate)

name: After-Tax Return
expr: After-Tax Return = Return × (1 − Tax Rate)

name: Price Elasticity of Demand
expr: PED = % Change in Quantity / % Change in Price

name: Income Elasticity of Demand
expr: YED = % Change in Quantity / % Change in Income

name: Cross Elasticity of Demand
expr: XED = % Change in Qty of A / % Change in Price of B

name: Total Revenue
expr: TR = Price × Quantity

name: Marginal Revenue
expr: MR = ΔTotal Revenue / ΔQuantity

name: Average Revenue
expr: AR = Total Revenue / Quantity

name: Profit Maximization Rule
expr: Profit is maximized where MR = MC

name: GDP (Expenditure Approach)
expr: GDP = C + I + G + (X − M)

name: Keynesian Multiplier
expr: Multiplier = 1 / (1 − MPC)

name: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC)
expr: MPC = ΔConsumption / ΔIncome

name: GDP Deflator
expr: GDP Deflator = (Nominal GDP / Real GDP) × 100

name: Real GDP
expr: Real GDP = (Nominal GDP / GDP Deflator) × 100

name: Consumer Price Index (CPI)
expr: CPI = (Cost of Basket in Current Year / Cost in Base Year) × 100

name: Unemployment Rate
expr: Unemployment Rate = (Unemployed / Labour Force) × 100

name: Balance of Trade
expr: Balance of Trade = Exports − Imports

name: Equation of Exchange
expr: M × V = P × T

name: Audit Risk Model
expr: Audit Risk = Inherent Risk × Control Risk × Detection Risk

name: Benford's Law
expr: P(d) = log₁₀(1 + 1/d)

name: Materiality Threshold (concept)
expr: a misstatement is material if it could influence users' economic decisions

name: Sampling Interval
expr: Interval = Population Value / Sample Size

name: Cost Variance Ratio
expr: Cost Variance % = ((Actual Cost − Standard Cost) / Standard Cost) × 100

name: Working Capital Ratio Trend (Days)
expr: Working Capital Days = (Working Capital / Sales) × 365

name: Inventory Shrinkage
expr: Shrinkage = Book Inventory − Physical Inventory

name: Accounts Receivable Aging Provision
expr: Provision = Σ (Aging Bucket Balance × Estimated Uncollectible %)

name: Cash Sales Percentage
expr: Cash Sales % = (Cash Sales / Total Sales) × 100

name: Gross Profit Margin on Cost
expr: GP on Cost % = (Gross Profit / COGS) × 100

name: Going Concern Concept (concept)
expr: assumes the business will continue operating in the foreseeable future

name: Accrual Concept (concept)
expr: revenues and expenses are recorded when earned or incurred, not when cash is received or paid

name: Matching Principle (concept)
expr: expenses are recorded in the same period as the revenues they helped earn

name: Prudence Concept (concept)
expr: anticipate no profit but provide for all possible losses

name: Consistency Concept (concept)
expr: the same accounting methods are applied from one period to the next

name: Business Entity Concept (concept)
expr: the business is treated as separate from its owner

name: Money Measurement Concept (concept)
expr: only transactions that can be expressed in money are recorded

name: Dual Aspect Concept (concept)
expr: every transaction has two equal effects: a debit and a credit

name: Revenue Recognition Principle (concept)
expr: revenue is recognized when it is earned, regardless of when cash is received

name: Historical Cost Concept (concept)
expr: assets are recorded at their original purchase cost

name: Full Disclosure Principle (concept)
expr: all information material to users of the statements must be disclosed

name: Debit and Credit Rules (concept)
expr: Assets & Expenses: Debit increases; Liabilities, Capital & Income: Credit increases

name: Capital vs Revenue Expenditure (concept)
expr: capital expenditure gives long-term benefit and is capitalized; revenue expenditure is expensed in the period

name: FIFO Inventory Method (concept)
expr: the oldest inventory is assumed sold first, so closing stock is valued at the latest costs

name: Weighted Average Cost Method (Inventory)
expr: Average Cost per Unit = Total Cost of Goods Available / Total Units Available

name: Lower of Cost and NRV (IAS 2) (concept)
expr: inventory is valued at the lower of its cost and its net realizable value

name: Contingent Liability (IAS 37) (concept)
expr: a possible obligation whose existence depends on uncertain future events, disclosed but not recorded

name: Goodwill on Acquisition
expr: Goodwill = Purchase Consideration − Fair Value of Net Identifiable Assets

name: Purchase Consideration (Net Assets Method)
expr: Purchase Consideration = Assets Taken Over − Liabilities Taken Over

name: Non-Controlling (Minority) Interest
expr: NCI = Minority % × Net Assets of Subsidiary

name: Cost of Control
expr: Cost of Control = Cost of Investment − Parent's Share of Subsidiary Equity at Acquisition

name: Equity Method Carrying Value
expr: Carrying Value = Cost + Share of Profit − Dividends Received

name: Unrealized Profit in Closing Stock
expr: Unrealized Profit = Unsold Inter-Company Stock × Profit %

name: Impairment Loss
expr: Impairment Loss = Carrying Amount − Recoverable Amount

name: Recoverable Amount (IAS 36)
expr: Recoverable Amount = Higher of (Fair Value − Disposal Costs) and Value in Use

name: Revaluation Surplus
expr: Revaluation Surplus = Fair Value − Carrying Amount

name: Depreciation after Revaluation
expr: Depreciation = (Revalued Amount − Residual Value) / Remaining Useful Life

name: Warranty Provision
expr: Provision = Units Sold × Warranty Cost per Unit × Expected Claim %

name: Percentage of Completion Revenue
expr: Revenue = Contract Price × (Cost Incurred to Date / Total Estimated Cost)

name: Unearned Revenue Recognized
expr: Revenue Earned = Total Contract Value × (Months Elapsed / Total Months)

name: Foreign Currency Translation Gain/Loss
expr: Gain/Loss = Foreign Amount × (Closing Rate − Transaction Rate)

name: Share-Based Payment Expense
expr: Expense = Options Granted × Fair Value per Option × Vesting Portion

name: Capitalized Borrowing Costs
expr: Capitalized Cost = Weighted Average Expenditure × Capitalization Rate

name: Straight-Line Operating Lease Expense
expr: Annual Expense = Total Lease Payments / Lease Term

name: Bad Debt Expense (Percentage of Sales)
expr: Bad Debt Expense = Credit Sales × Estimated Uncollectible %

name: Provident Fund Contribution
expr: Contribution = Basic Salary × Contribution Rate

name: Relative Valuation (Peer Multiple)
expr: Implied Price = Peer Multiple × Company Metric

name: Residual Income Valuation
expr: Value = Book Value₀ + Σ [RIₜ / (1 + r)ᵗ]

name: Adjusted Present Value (APV)
expr: APV = Base-Case NPV + PV of Financing Side Effects

name: Net Asset Value per Share
expr: NAV per Share = (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) / Shares Outstanding

name: Terminal Value (Exit Multiple)
expr: TV = Final-Year EBITDA × Exit Multiple

name: Free Cash Flow Yield
expr: FCF Yield = Free Cash Flow / Market Capitalization

name: Dividend Cover Ratio
expr: Dividend Cover = Net Income / Dividends

name: EPS Growth Rate
expr: EPS Growth % = ((EPS₁ − EPS₀) / EPS₀) × 100

name: Sales Growth Rate
expr: Sales Growth % = ((Sales₁ − Sales₀) / Sales₀) × 100

name: Equity Turnover Ratio
expr: Equity Turnover = Net Sales / Average Shareholders' Equity

name: Operating Return on Assets
expr: Operating ROA = EBIT / Average Total Assets

name: Financial Leverage Index
expr: FLI = ROE / ROA

name: Piotroski F-Score (concept)
expr: sum of 9 binary tests (profitability, leverage/liquidity, efficiency); a higher score signals stronger fundamentals

name: Cash Burn Rate
expr: Burn Rate = Cash Outflow per Month

name: Cash Runway
expr: Runway (Months) = Cash Balance / Monthly Burn Rate

name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
expr: CAC = Total Sales & Marketing Cost / New Customers Acquired

name: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
expr: LTV = (ARPU × Gross Margin %) / Churn Rate

name: LTV to CAC Ratio
expr: LTV:CAC = Customer Lifetime Value / Customer Acquisition Cost

name: CAC Payback Period
expr: Payback (Months) = CAC / (ARPU per Month × Gross Margin %)

name: Customer Churn Rate
expr: Churn % = (Customers Lost / Customers at Start) × 100

name: Customer Retention Rate
expr: Retention % = ((End Customers − New Customers) / Start Customers) × 100

name: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
expr: MRR = Number of Paying Customers × ARPU

name: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
expr: ARR = MRR × 12

name: Conversion Rate
expr: Conversion Rate = (Orders / Visitors) × 100

name: Average Order Value (AOV)
expr: AOV = Total Revenue / Number of Orders

name: Cart Abandonment Rate
expr: Abandonment % = (1 − Completed Purchases / Carts Created) × 100

name: Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
expr: ROAS = Revenue from Ads / Ad Spend

name: Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
expr: CPA = Total Campaign Cost / Number of Conversions

name: Sell-Through Rate
expr: Sell-Through % = (Units Sold / Units Received) × 100

name: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
expr: GMV = Units Sold × Average Selling Price

name: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
expr: NPS = % Promoters − % Detractors

name: Tax-Exclusive Price
expr: Price Excluding Tax = Tax-Inclusive Price / (1 + Tax Rate)

name: Withholding Tax Amount
expr: WHT = Gross Payment × Withholding Rate

name: Net Payment after Withholding
expr: Net Payment = Gross Payment − Withholding Tax

name: Islamic Savings Account Profit
expr: Profit = Average Balance × Annual Profit Rate × Days / 365

name: KIBOR-Linked Financing Rate
expr: Rate = KIBOR + Spread

name: Musharakah Loss Sharing
expr: Partner's Loss = (Partner's Capital / Total Capital) × Total Loss

name: Diminishing Musharakah Rent
expr: Rent = Bank's Share Value × Rental Rate × Time

name: Sukuk Periodic Distribution
expr: Distribution = Face Value × Expected Profit Rate × Period

name: Loan-to-Deposit Ratio
expr: LDR = (Total Loans / Total Deposits) × 100

name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
expr: Cost-to-Income = (Operating Expenses / Operating Income) × 100

name: NPL Coverage Ratio
expr: Coverage = (Loan Loss Provisions / Non-Performing Loans) × 100

name: Yield on Advances
expr: Yield = Interest Earned on Advances / Average Advances

name: Cost of Funds
expr: Cost of Funds = Interest Expense / Average Interest-Bearing Liabilities

name: Statutory Liquidity Requirement
expr: Required Liquid Assets = Net Demand & Time Liabilities × SLR %

name: Position Size
expr: Position Size = Risk Amount / (Entry Price − Stop-Loss Price)

name: Risk-Reward Ratio
expr: Risk-Reward = (Target − Entry) / (Entry − Stop-Loss)

name: Average Cost per Share (Averaging)
expr: Average Cost = Total Amount Invested / Total Shares Bought

name: Break-Even Price (with Commission)
expr: Break-Even = Buy Price + (Total Commission / Shares)

name: Margin Leverage
expr: Leverage = Total Position Value / Equity Invested

name: Margin Call Price (Long Position)
expr: Margin Call Price = Purchase Price × (1 − Initial Margin) / (1 − Maintenance Margin)
